column5: Scores are analyst judgments, not published facts. Each partner is rated 1–5 on Audience Overlap (25%), Referral Potential (20%), Strategic Fit (20%), Ease of Activation (15%), Trust (10%), and Expected Acquisition Impact (10%). The model is designed to prioritize partners that combine strong user relevance with a realistic path to activation.
